title: Tree attaining deterministic depth
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let $f:(\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\Omega)\to\alpha$. There exists a decision tree that computes $f$ and whose depth equals the least depth of any decision tree computing $f$.
